rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is the primary serial number and mandatory join key. While no nulls exist in the sample, this rule ensures future data integrity.

rule: S_N must be unique across the dataset
rationale: Serial numbers should uniquely identify records. The sample shows 30 distinct values for 30 records, indicating a uniqueness constraint should be enforced.

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N (one-to-one relationship)
rationale: S_N is defined as a one-to-one join key with Acc_Info_dirty. Every customer bio record must have a corresponding account info record.

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account number is a mandatory business identifier for linking customer records to accounts.

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit code
rationale: Dominant observed format is 4 digits (derived from the data distribution). Values of different lengths are likely truncated, padded, or sentinel values.

rule: Account_No should not be duplicated (flag for business review)
rationale: Evidence shows 2 duplicate account numbers (1001, 1010) which may represent valid multi-customer accounts or data errors. This rule flags duplicates for clarification.

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Customer name is a mandatory field for identity verification and communication.

rule: Name must use Title Case (flag all-caps or all-lowercase words except cultural particles)
rationale: Sample contains 'lim wei jie' (all lowercase) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all caps) which deviate from the dominant Title Case convention. Cultural particles (bin, binte, d/o, s/o) are exempt.

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() and not w.isupper()) or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o for Male, Binte/d/o for Female)
rationale: Malay and Indian naming conventions use specific particles: 'Bin' and 's/o' indicate male; 'Binte' and 'd/o' indicate female. Mismatches suggest data entry errors.

check_params.logic: (re.search(r'\bbin\b|\bs/o\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male') or (re.search(r'\bbinte\b|\bd/o\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female')

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID is a mandatory unique identifier for customer identity verification.

rule: ID_No must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one letter
rationale: 93.3% of values follow the standard format (e.g., S1234567D). Deviations like 'F212233V' (6 digits) and '1916569C' (missing prefix) are anomalies requiring validation.

rule: ID_No must not be a test or placeholder value
rationale: Value 'F0000000X' appears to be a test/sentinel value using sequential zeros, which is not a valid issued ID.

rule: ID_No must be unique across the dataset
rationale: National ID numbers should uniquely identify individuals. Evidence shows 'F1011121T' appears in 2 records, indicating potential duplication.

rule: ID_No prefix must be consistent with Age (S prefix implies Age >= 24, T prefix implies Age <= 24 as of 2024)
rationale: Singapore NRIC prefixes indicate birth era: S = before 2000 (age >= 24), T = 2000 onwards (age <= 24). Foreigner prefixes (F/G) are exempt.

check_params.logic: (str(row['ID_No']).upper().startswith('S') and pd.to_numeric(row['Age'], errors='coerce') < 24) or (str(row['ID_No']).upper().startswith('T') and pd.to_numeric(row['Age'], errors='coerce') > 24)

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Race is a mandatory demographic field for the dataset.

rule: Race must be one of the canonical values: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Evidence shows only three semantic categories with casing variations (MALAY, malay, indian). Values must conform to standard Title Case enumeration.

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Gender is a mandatory demographic field.

rule: Gender must be exactly 'Male' or 'Female' (Title Case)
rationale: Evidence shows variations 'male' and 'FEMALE'. Standardization to Title Case is required for consistency.

rule: Age must be parseable as an integer
rationale: Column contains non-numeric text 'Twenty-five' which cannot be processed as a numeric age value.

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint for human age. Values like -5 are impossible and values above 120 are unrealistic.

rule: Age must be at least 13 for a consumer service account
rationale: Evidence indicates ages below 13 (e.g., 4) may be unrealistic for this service account context and require verification.

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Contact number is required for customer communication. Evidence shows 6.7% missing values (2 records) that need to be addressed.

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (8 digits, starting with 6, 8, or 9, with optional +65 prefix)
rationale: All numbers appear to be Singapore-based. Standard format is +65 XXXXXXXX or 65 XXXXXXXX with 8 digits. One value '8964359' has only 7 digits.

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is a mandatory contact field for customer communications.

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol and no whitespace characters
rationale: Evidence shows 4 malformed emails: 'not-an-email' (missing @), 'useremail.com' (missing @), 'zx91 @example.com' (contains space), 'nabilah@@example.com' (double @).

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Country is a mandatory geographic field for address validation and regional compliance.

rule: Country must be exactly 'Singapore' (canonical form)
rationale: Evidence shows 8 variations of Singapore (SG, S'pore, Singapura, 新加坡, etc.). All must be standardized to the canonical 'Singapore'.

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is a mandatory component of the physical address.

rule: Street_Name must not contain all-uppercase words
rationale: Sample contains 'HOLLAND ROAD' in all caps, deviating from the dominant Title Case format used in 96.7% of records.

check_params.logic: any(w.isupper() and len(w) > 1 for w in str(row['Street_Name']).split())

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is mandatory for address validation and mail delivery.

rule: Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits when represented as a string
rationale: Singapore postal codes are strictly 6 digits. Evidence shows 4-digit (6907) and 5-digit (99999) values suggesting leading zero truncation or foreign codes. Must be converted to string and padded to 6 digits.

rule: Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (case-insensitive)
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires name consistency across tables. Discrepancies like 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin' vs 'Danish' or 'S8421753J' vs 'S8421753X' indicate synchronization errors.

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name from Acc_Info_dirty (allowing for case differences and word order variations)

rule: ID_No must exactly match ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires ID consistency. Sample shows mismatch S8421753J vs S8421753X (different checksum letter) which must be flagged.

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must exactly match ID from Acc_Info_dirty

rule: Account_No must match Account_No in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: One-to-one relationship via S_N requires account number consistency across customer bio and account info tables.

check_params.semantic_check: Account_No must match Account_No from Acc_Info_dirty
